author: Razer, AmstaFF, Frizzlehead9, Robsonfire, Ton!x, Silverlol, Hellraisedsurfer, Nitro
notes: Credit only, no zones yet, on purpose (gb-maps-1, 2026-10-09): a race-then-fight surf map. Sections named after animals (froggy, penguin_1/11, kitty, bear-spawn, spawn_zebra, dog, shark_hell, amstaff_stage, poco), but the route is driven by the map's logic rather than a gate chain: 33 func_buttons, and per section a family of start-disabled teleports that hand each team a weapon by race position (t_m4a1 / ct_m4a1 ... t_knife, t_lose, t_lose_last_stage) and a fight_tele into the poco arena, all turned on by outputs this importer does not run. A finish guessed from that would time a route the map does not have; read the outputs (as surf_lt_omnific's were) or draw the zones in-game. Loads, draws and collides. Not published.
